government.about: Government bodies: one page each, whatever name a document uses. The patterns catch bodies not listed; the list is generic, with Malaysia's filled in. A name a business could also go by (an everyday word such as Hasil, Bomba or Kastam, or two letters such as SC) is never an alias here: a party named exactly as an alias is put on the body's page.
